description: Check how well a website welcomes AI agents: robots.txt rules for AI bots, llms.txt, sitemap, search indexing, title and description, A2A agent card, MCP endpoint, OpenAPI description, and whether automated visitors are blocked. Returns what is there, what is missing and how to fix it.

fresh.description: Optional: check again now instead of using a result from the last 10 minutes, for example after a fix. The answer then says what changed.

url.description: The website to check, for example https://example.com.

name: check_site
title: Agent-readiness check
